faq.title: Video Studio FAQ
faq.description: Commonly asked questions about our private, browser-based video processing tool.

items.q: Can I compress large video files in my browser?
items.a: Yes! Our Video Studio uses a high-performance FFmpeg WASM engine that runs locally. You can compress MP4, MOV, and WebM files directly in your browser without uploading them to a server, ensuring 100% privacy for your personal videos.

items.q: Is there a file size limit for video conversion?
items.a: Since the processing happens locally, the limit depends on your device's RAM and browser capabilities. Most modern browsers can handle files up to 500MB-1GB smoothly.

items.q: What video formats can I convert between?
items.a: We support major formats like MP4, WebM, MOV, and GIF. You can also extract audio from videos and convert it to MP3 or WAV formats.
